judge.evidence_requirement: For every routing assertion, quote or reference exact Skill lifecycle evidence. Contract fixtures prove only observable activation boundaries, not semantic routing effectiveness.

dimensions.description: Checks lifecycle evidence that direct assessment requests and canonical invocation select Engineering Guidance.
Checks lifecycle evidence that implementation and Code Review remain owning outcomes and load Engineering Guidance only as a declared dependency.
Checks lifecycle evidence that generic writing, product planning, ticket decomposition, and generic non-code requests do not select Engineering Guidance.
Checks lifecycle evidence that To Humans may be independently selected without becoming an Engineering Guidance dependency.

evals.name: canonical direct invocation
evals.prompt:
/engineering-guidance

Assess this bounded implementation approach against repository authority.
evals.expected_output: The canonical public outcome is selected directly.

evals.name: ambient engineering approach assessment
evals.prompt: Assess whether this repository's proposed cache invalidation approach is maintainable and follows the applicable standards.
evals.expected_output: Engineering Guidance is selected for the direct assessment.
expectations: engineering-guidance loads for the direct assessment.
The request remains guidance rather than implementation or Code Review.

evals.name: human-facing guidance with independent Audience outcome
evals.prompt: Assess this retry approach and explain the guidance clearly to me.
evals.expected_output: Engineering Guidance owns the assessment while To Humans is independently selected for expression.
expectations: engineering-guidance loads as the Primary outcome.
to-humans and writing-foundation may load independently for the human-facing response.
No invocation edge exists between engineering-guidance and to-humans.

evals.name: technical non-code artifact assessment
evals.prompt: Assess this CI workflow change against repository authority and failure-handling concerns. Do not edit it.
evals.expected_output: Engineering Guidance is selected for the technical assessment even though the artifact is YAML.
expectations: engineering-guidance loads for a technical non-code artifact.

evals.name: implementation remains owning outcome
evals.prompt: Implement ticket 812 in the isolated worktree and return its implementation handoff.
evals.expected_output: Implement owns the request and invokes Engineering Guidance inside its workflow rather than routing the user request directly to Engineering Guidance.
expectations: The direct user outcome is implement.
Engineering Guidance is not independently selected as another user deliverable.

evals.name: Code Review remains owning outcome
evals.prompt: Review immutable range base..head and return evidence-backed findings.
evals.expected_output: Code Review owns the request and its Review worker may invoke Engineering Guidance as a declared dependency.
expectations: The direct user outcome is code-review.
Engineering Guidance is not selected as the findings owner.

evals.name: generic writing exclusion
evals.prompt: Rewrite this project update so it is easier for the leadership team to scan.
evals.expected_output: A writing outcome handles the request without Engineering Guidance.

evals.name: product planning exclusion
evals.prompt: Prioritize these product ideas for the next quarter and explain the customer value.
evals.expected_output: Product planning remains outside Engineering Guidance.

evals.name: ticket decomposition exclusion
evals.prompt: Split this settled requirement into a dependency-aware ticket plan.
evals.expected_output: The planning outcome owns ticket decomposition.
expectations: engineering-guidance is not selected as the planning owner.

evals.name: generic non-code work exclusion
evals.prompt: Summarize these meeting notes and list the attendees.
evals.expected_output: Generic non-code work does not select Engineering Guidance.
